integrity: Finite rational and lattice checks are ancillary evidence; the finite-n and n-to-infinity theorems rest on the included symbolic proof. No independent validation is claimed.
scientific_limitations: Deterministic equal arcs and uniform independent starts only. The covariance moment identity is potentially a special case of Huffer (1988); priority for the global one-zero classification and two-term threshold expansion remains unverified against unavailable full historical text. No assertion for unequal arcs or interval boundary effects.
title: A unique vacancy–fragmentation covariance transition in random circular arc covering
